children: said Wednesday it plans to invest more than $10B in capital and operating expenses in the Middle East through 2030 as it expands cloud and AI infrastructure in Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates.
The company said the investment will include expanding cloud and AI capacity and working with governments and local organizations on AI projects.

Microsoft also plans to invest more than $400M in subsea and terrestrial connectivity in the region by 2030. The company said the spending will expand network capacity and provide alternative routes for data traffic during disruptions.
The company said it will work with organizations including Saudi Arabia's HUMAIN and SDAIA, Abu Dhabi's G42, Qatar's QAI, and the governments of Kuwait and the UAE.
Microsoft said it will also work with local partners on infrastructure that uses less water and on expanding access to carbon-free electricity as it builds out cloud and AI facilities.
The company said its Middle East plans will initially focus on Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE.

title: Microsoft plans more than $10B investment in Middle East through 2030
